mydaleine.definition:
n. A toxic alkaloid (ptomaine) obtained from putrid flesh
   and from herring brines. As a poison it is said to execute profuse
   diarrhoea, vomiting, and intestinal inflammation.

mydatoxin.definition:
n. A poisonous amido acid, C6H13NO2, separated by Brieger
   from decaying horseflesh. In physiological action, it is similar to
   curare.

mydocalm.translation: 盐酸甲苯哌丙酮; 甲苯哌丙酮

mydriasis.definition: n. reflex pupillary dilation as a muscle pulls the iris outward; occurs in response to a decrease in light or certain drugs
mydriasis.translation:
n. 瞳孔放大
[医] 瞳孔开大, 瞳孔散大, 瞳孔扩大

mydriatic.definition: n. a drug that causes the pupil of the eye to dilate; used to aid eye examinations
mydriatic.translation:
a. 瞳孔放大
[化] 散瞳药; 放大瞳孔的

mydriatine.translation: [医] 盐酸去甲麻黄硷(商品名)

mydrine.translation: [医] 米得林(后马托吕麻黄硷合剂)
